headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.1
summary: Merges upstream 1.6.0 (Minecraft 26.60 support, hideable launcher HUD, world map and NBT editing) on top of the fork's freeze and theme fixes.

items.text: Support for Minecraft 26.60 — updated libinbuiltmods signatures and preloader signature rules.
New option to hide the launcher HUD and overlay buttons.
World map, advanced NBT editing and performance optimisations.

Recurring in-game freezes: Hotbar Slot hooks stay gated, overlay visibility debounce, preloader hooks skipped when unused, ClientModBridge overlay gated, and the thread freeze sampler under App-Level Logging.
AMOLED theme survives game sessions; xCrash fork ANR watchdog stays disabled so game launches are not interrupted.
Launcher image caches clear before the game loads to reduce memory pressure on low-RAM devices.
